units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 47:19">Targ. O. Gen. XLVII, 19</cite>.—Part. <cite ref="B00599"><he>בָּיִיר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 6b:5">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בָּיְירֵי וכ׳</he> the halls (academies) are not empty (oth. expl.: the gardens do not lie waste).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:15">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>, beg. he sees <he>חקליה בָּיְירָה וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>ביירא</he>) his field waste (in the Sabbath year) &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:3">B. Mets. IX, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 104b:9">Ib. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מוֹבַרְנָא לה</he> if I should let it lie waste.
